findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "p_instagram" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: instagram_actions_list_comments, instagram_get_ig_user_media, instagram_get_ig_media, instagram_get_ig_media_comments, instagram_get_ig_media_insights, instagram_post_ig_user_media_publish, instagram_mark_seen, instagram_get_conversation, instagram_list_all_conversations, instagram_list_all_messages · Private data: connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: instagram_actions_like, instagram_actions_list_comments, instagram_actions_send_message, instagram_get_ig_media, instagram_get_ig_media_comments, instagram_post_ig_user_media, instagram_create_carousel_container, instagram_post_ig_user_media_publish, instagram_post_ig_comment_replies, instagram_send_text_message, instagram_send_image, report_bug · Destructive: marketplace.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: instagram_actions_list_comments, instagram_get_ig_user_media, instagram_get_ig_media, instagram_get_ig_media_comments, instagram_get_ig_media_insights, instagram_post_ig_user_media_publish, instagram_mark_seen, instagram_get_conversation, instagram_list_all_conversations, instagram_list_all_messages · Private data: connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: instagram_actions_like, instagram_actions_list_comments, instagram_actions_send_message, instagram_get_ig_media, instagram_get_ig_media_comments, instagram_post_ig_user_media, instagram_create_carousel_container, instagram_post_ig_user_media_publish, instagram_post_ig_comment_replies, instagram_send_text_message, instagram_send_image, report_bug · Destructive: marketplace

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
